messages.subject: Re: plotting fisheries data
parts:
You can shrink the font to prevent them from overwriting the next one. 
p4+opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size=6))

You could try changing the angle. 
p4+opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(angle=270))

You could try changing the dpi of the output device.
quartz(dpi=50)


You can also stretch the open output device window. 
quartz(width=10, height=5)

Should also work with window() and x11() if you're not mac'n...

B 

P.S. thanks for the example, makes it so easy to play with.

thank a lot again

JC
